title: A koi made of 10,000 dots
summary: One short formula draws a koi that swims forever.
brief: Draw a swimming koi from ten thousand white points on a dark canvas. Let its tail turn and its fins ripple in a continuous loop.

prompts.text: Open this post by @yuruyurau and read its p5.js sketch: https://x.com/yuruyurau/status/2080977918914969636. It draws a koi from 10,000 white dots that curls and trails its fins on black. Recreate the sketch exactly as a web page that draws on a plain canvas, without p5.js or any other library: keep its formula, point count, colours and speed, and centre the 400 x 400 drawing on a black full-window page scaled to the window height. If you cannot open the post, tell me and ask me to paste the sketch from it. Build it in a new folder inside the current project folder, open it in the browser when it is done, check that it works, and ask me before installing or loading anything.
